claims.text: This is the old playbook of voluntary pledges all over again. The industry uses these moments to delay regulation while they build the thing they are pledging to control. Nothing is new, just early.

You are watching the demo of the next decade. By calling it superintelligence, they unlock the narrative shield. Watch what happens when the models actually get dangerous and this becomes the baseline.
The image of CEOs signing a paper that says we promise not to break anything while building things that might break everything is the perfect cartoon of modern governance.
No federal legislation will be passed in 2027 specifically citing this voluntary agreement as its primary catalyst.
By Q4 2027, at least one major AI provider will cite this voluntary framework to justify releasing a model that triggers new safety debates.
